lastReleaseMessage: Keep the preserved 256 px originals out of the build. The re-export kept each artist original beside its asset in _source256, but those folders sit under res:// so Godot imported them too and fourteen duplicate textures would have shipped in the export. Each folder now carries a .gdignore and the stray .import files are gone, so the originals stay in version control for re-running the resize and stay out of the game.

items: M1 gameplay vertical slice not yet assembled: Hold the Wall 5-7 wave mission script (bk-mission-hold, P1), Lantern Oil drain + mission-fail clock UI, Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX are all still pending per the GDD Roadmap tab (docs/GDD.html)
Wood Wall / Gate / Tower cell-occupant refactor (v0.14.0) and build-menu category-tab polish still pending

MVP art + audio integration ongoing and paced by Navy's delivery cadence: HUD rebuild, Spine2D rigs, and the terrain TileMapLayer migration landed through the v0.59.x series, but remaining unit/building art and MVP-scope audio are still outstanding

Basis for the 50% hold: the art-integration track has been the active work for weeks while the six gameplay slice deliverables above are unstarted; number is evidence-anchored here, not moved, and will only advance when a real gameplay deliverable lands

barRaise.topFinding: Six real commits landed since 2026-08-03, all art/asset/economy-doc work (Spine rig animation, a baked-sprite pipeline with real integrity gating, an economy audit that fixed real price disagreements, an Asset Master List rewrite). None touch the six M1 vertical-slice deliverables still unstarted per .project-context.json, and the movement-speed bug a 2026-07-29 commit only documented still ships live -- the Leviathan still outruns everything. Two save/load defects are live: loading a game silently drops completed research effects and every purchased Keeper upgrade. queue-drain-hourly has been disabled 10 days, BR's own 24-day-old queue items are getting zero triage, and the strategic-kill-this-vs-maintainability tension has gone unresolved for 27 consecutive runs. Health fell 75 to 66 on two newly-confirmed live bugs plus the orchestration gaps, offset partially by the one real strengthening this window: a solid new bake-integrity preship gate.

actions.title: Replace check_best_practices.py's stale GOD_FILES literal with a size-threshold scan over source/**/*.gd and regenerate the baseline so building.gd/wave_director.gd/settings.gd/enemy_pool.gd are actually ratcheted.
Replace check_best_practices.py's stale six-file GOD_FILES list with the current four-file watchlist so the preship ratchet actually measures live growth. (duplicate of architecture-01; land once)
Direct the next BR commit at one concrete M1 gameplay deliverable (mission script, Lantern Oil clock, Shambler/Lunger tuning, or Hatchery/Coral VFX) instead of continuing art-integration by default.
Add a death/release signal to enemy_pool and have wave_director subscribe to it for pool-routed spawns so _alive_count decrements on pool kills the same as Node kills.
Move the BR GDD gate behind real server-side auth or drop the gate pretense; the viewer/editor phrases are plaintext JS constants readable via view-source.
Call research._apply_effect for every id restored into _completed on load, and extend the save snapshot to carry _active/_progress research state.
Add keepers' owned/pick-index/reroll/offer state and economy's waves-repelled/first-tent-relief flags to the save snapshot and restore path.
Strip or re-derive docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's hardcoded line-number anchors, which have drifted on every sample checked including one past end-of-file.
Extend check_clone_completeness.py to fail when a tracked .gd/.tscn references SpineSprite/SpineAnimationState but the spine-godot GDExtension binary is missing from git ls-files.
Wire tools/verify_pool_orientation.gd (or a headless equivalent) into preship.ps1 so a future shader/renderer regression of the same orientation-bug class fails the gate instead of shipping silently.
Write a parser that reads the newest CANONICAL_AUDIT-*.md's severity counts into the dashboard's audit.findings block instead of always carrying forward the last written value.
Run adr-promoter on the strategic-kill-this <-> maintainability tension now that it has re-surfaced for 27 consecutive runs with no decision.

Land the movement-speed code fix (pick one scale convention, drop the duplicate TILE_W/32 or the 0.5 halving) so the shipped speeds match the audited design column, including rebalancing the Leviathan.
Sequence a real gameplay pass (Shambler/Lunger tuning or the Hold-the-Wall mission script) before further art-track work; none of the six named M1 deliverables have moved.
Re-enable queue-drain-hourly (disabled 10 days) or split its stale-item-triage duty into a task that still runs; BR's oldest queue item is now 24 days old with zero triage.
Add a hard per-project deadline check to the bar-raise rotation so a sibling project's long fan-out can't push another project's forced-full-pass date past its own 7-day deadline.
Strip 'Cowork' from docs/GDD.html:3290/:3647 and CHANGELOG.md:249, matching the clean rewrite already done for the same event at GDD.html:3275.
Re-sync the solo-dev-voice-audit plugin snapshot from source, add a Brackish Rising row to its enforcement table, and add 'Cowork' to its AI-tool-name pattern.
Correct the stale BACKLOG.md 'Hold the Wall 5-7 wave mission' DONE row and either retarget m1_default.tres to the locked 5-7 minute shape or author the real vertical-slice mission fixture.
Give tools/bake_spine_sheets.gd's _bake() the same tmp-file + readback + atomic-rename pattern save_load.gd already uses, for both the PNG and the metadata JSON.

Add nightly-sweep and bar-raise-rotating to collect-usage.ps1's PROJECT_PATTERNS; Rising's dashboard cost is currently inverted (~6x) against Hordes on days when the opposite project actually ran the expensive fan-out.
Add a NOTICE/CREDITS.md to the release build recording the Spine Runtimes License terms and which party's Spine seat authorizes the shipped skeleton data.
Delete the duplicate Bilgemaw fortification-bonus string-match table and drive it from the actual building_name/is_fortification flag instead of two hardcoded (and stale) 'Watchtower' lists.
Branch on the returned bool in save_picker.gd's _on_save/_on_load and surface a failure state in the picker UI, mirroring the F6/F7 hotkey toast.
Extend check_secret_exposure.py to scan the resolved publish target (brackish-rising/index.html) where the gate phrases actually ship.
Capture a peak-wave profile with the new baked-sheet path active and append it to OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md, which has read "no profile captured yet" through six commits.
Update the Harpoon/Repeater/Mortar Battery build-menu tooltips to the shipped damage/fire-rate/radius constants, matching the fix already applied to Tryworks in the same commit.
Loop crowd_render_manager.build() over a data table of (type_id, dir, base) so a new baked rig needs only a data row, or correct the 'no code change' claim in docs/commits.
Make the BACKLOG.md milestone-cell match tolerant of composite cells like 'M0 -> M1' instead of exact-match, and emit a matched-of-total denominator.
Add Brackish Rising to the adr-promoter routing table and cross-project-status-digest repos list; both currently hardcode a 4-project roster that omits BR.
Pick one canonical registration for handler-audit/project-canonical-audit (they exist twice, diverged) and retire the losing copy.
Give push-to-github.ps1 its own version-validation check so a direct invocation can't stamp an arbitrary, unvalidated version series into git history (already happened once, v0.16.7).
Reconcile the #rising-resources digest channel: either create its webhook file or correct the docs/comments to say #rising-audit, which is where digests actually land.
Route mission_setup.seed_idle_enemies through the same wave_director/enemy_pool dispatcher wave spawns use, or document the idle-vs-pool render split as a deliberate decision.
Hoist the baked-sprite branch outside the per-instance render loop in enemy_renderer.update_instances so the hot path has no per-instance branch/call overhead.
Add headless test coverage for enemy_pool and settings, starting with a pool spawn-then-release test asserting the alive counter returns to zero.
Add scripts/bake.ps1 wrapping the bake + import + check_baked_sheets.py steps in one command, matching every other repeated-task wrapper convention.
Record the locked spine-godot/Godot/Spine-editor version triple in a machine-readable file and check it against baked-sheet metadata at preship.
Invoke write-dashboard-status.ps1 from the nightly canonical-audit routine, not only from release.ps1, so the audit block doesn't go stale between releases.
Add a hit-frame signal or event track on the Shambler's Attack clip so the rig's swing and the tick-based damage application agree.
Capture one peak-wave frame-time profile now that the baked-sheet renderer is live and record it as the first OPTIMIZATION_LOG.md baseline.
Replace the enumerated webhook filenames in .gitignore with a glob (.discord_*) so a new webhook file is covered automatically.
Add token-shaped content patterns (ghp_, github_pat_, sk-, 40-hex) to check_secret_exposure.py's detection.
Adopt git-lfs for assets/art or rewrite history to drop the ~350MB of superseded Delete/ art blobs bloating .git to ~490MB.
Write the BR-vs-HBH priority ADR naming which project gets the next block of hours.
Inject an explicit HUD/grid reference at scene-setup time instead of wave_director's parent-tree name/type walk in _find_hud().
Add a push_warning on crowd_render_manager's texture-load-failure branch so a corrupt baked PNG doesn't fail silently.
Migrate user://options.tres to a verified-JSON shape or add an explicit type hint plus post-load field validation to the ResourceLoader.load call.
Re-derive the dashboard's work-queue depth on the same nightly cadence as the audit block rather than only at release time.
Write an artist-facing doc stating the branch/push convention and the exact clip-name contract the bake pipeline hardcodes.
